notes: Android security patch level per Samsung firmware build, from Samsung's own Notify-Update publisher.

Day-of-month distribution was verified at collection: a column landing on any day other than 01 or 05 is refused, because a scattered day means the value is a RELEASE date wearing the patch level's name.
spl is a full date; 01 and 05 are Google's two patch tiers and the distinction decides which CVEs a build can adjudicate.
